name: h-reader-extension
description: A simple local RSS reader with optional sync.
author: Erik Brinkman

scripts.export: rm -rf dist && bun build src/background.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --minify && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist/icons
scripts.pack: rm -rf store h-reader-extension.zip && bun build src/background.ts --outdir store --target browser --format esm --minify && cp manifest.json store/manifest.json && cp -r icons store/icons && bun scripts/store-manifest.ts store && (cd store && zip -r -X ../h-reader-extension.zip .) && rm -rf store
scripts.icons: rm -rf icons && mkdir icons && for size in 16 32 48 128; do rsvg-convert -w $size -h $size ../design/icons/logo.svg -o icons/icon-$size.png; done
